svg.title: Turn One Sourcing Cohort into Documented Acquisitions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-acquisition-cohorts; chart type: funnel; title: Turn One Sourcing Cohort into Documented Acquisitions; subtitle: Five nested cohorts, with explicit denominators and no revenue claims.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative cohort contains 500 distinct seller-interest packages, deduplicated by owner, tract, and conveyed estate. Every later stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Counts are planning assumptions over a 6–24 month acquisition cycle, not observed conversions or a 30-day closing forecast.; caption: The cohort narrows 500 → 200 → 80 → 20 → 3. Final conversion is 0.6% of screened packages; acquisition count alone does not establish annual royalty revenue.; stages: label: Screen distinct seller and interest packages; value: 500 packages enter the documented source cohort; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Capture owner contact provenance, county, legal description, claimed estate, and asking price. Separate duplicate broker listings from distinct interests before calculating any downstream conversion rate.; label: Confirm interest and obtain usable documents; value: 200 packages qualify; 40% of screened cohort; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Obtain seller authority, relevant recorded instruments, and permission to review statements when producing. Exclude packages whose seller cannot identify the conveyed estate or provide a workable document trail.; label: Pass preliminary title and engineering review; value: 80 packages survive; 40% of documented cohort; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Screen ownership defects, production decline, pricing differentials, lease deductions, and development timing. Record the specific failure reason for every rejected package to improve subsequent sourcing.; label: Issue supported and conditional purchase offers; value: 20 packages receive offers; 25% of reviewed cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Attach supported ownership math, price sensitivity, diligence conditions, and a maximum cash commitment. Do not bid contingent drilling upside as though an operator has already scheduled first production.; label: Close and complete recorded ownership transfers; value: 3 packages close; 15% of offered cohort; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Count an acquisition only after executed closing documents, required funds movement, and confirmed recordation. Track operator pay-status updates separately; closing does not establish immediate royalty collection.

text.title: Turn One Sourcing Cohort into Documented Acquisitions

rect.title: label: Screen distinct seller and interest packages; value: 500 packages enter the documented source cohort; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Capture owner contact provenance, county, legal description, claimed estate, and asking price. Separate duplicate broker listings from distinct interests before calculating any downstream conversion rate.

text.title: Screen distinct seller and interest packages: 500

rect.title: label: Confirm interest and obtain usable documents; value: 200 packages qualify; 40% of screened cohort; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Obtain seller authority, relevant recorded instruments, and permission to review statements when producing. Exclude packages whose seller cannot identify the conveyed estate or provide a workable document trail.

text.title: Confirm interest and obtain usable documents: 200

rect.title: label: Pass preliminary title and engineering review; value: 80 packages survive; 40% of documented cohort; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Screen ownership defects, production decline, pricing differentials, lease deductions, and development timing. Record the specific failure reason for every rejected package to improve subsequent sourcing.

text.title: Pass preliminary title and engineering review: 80

rect.title: label: Issue supported and conditional purchase offers; value: 20 packages receive offers; 25% of reviewed cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Attach supported ownership math, price sensitivity, diligence conditions, and a maximum cash commitment. Do not bid contingent drilling upside as though an operator has already scheduled first production.

text.title: Issue supported and conditional purchase offers: 20

rect.title: label: Close and complete recorded ownership transfers; value: 3 packages close; 15% of offered cohort; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Count an acquisition only after executed closing documents, required funds movement, and confirmed recordation. Track operator pay-status updates separately; closing does not establish immediate royalty collection.

text.title: Close and complete recorded ownership transfers: 3

Assumptions: Illustrative cohort contains 500 distinct seller-interest packages, deduplicated by owner, tract, and conveyed estate. Every later stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Counts are planning assumptions over a 6–24 month acquisition cycle, not observed conversions or a 30-day closing forecast.
